rulings.why: Confirmed: classFeatures['precise-strike'] is reachable at swashbuckler L1 but carries zero engine fields and no code in src/ mentions it (strikePrecisionRiders, derive.ts:1073, knows only sneak-attack and the ranger precision edge). Situational strikeDamage is the right lane and the shape is legal.

Confirmed: trainedSkillChoice ['crafting','society'], no grantedFeatId, choice flag 'tradeSkill' only records. Text: 'Seasoned if you chose Crafting or Streetwise if you chose Society'; both ids exist; grantedFeatByChoice is read first by backgroundGrantedFeats (build.ts:336) keyed on build.backgroundSkillChoice. Fix is exact.

Confirmed: no field, no registry key; 'fast-recovery' exists in core.feats and grantedFeatId is legal. Note fast-recovery itself has no engine fields, so the grant adds the feat row and prerequisite eligibility rather than a statistic - still the correct lane.

Real but the fix is incomplete: Formation Training is a printed PREREQUISITE, so the character always owns both and adding an identical bonus set would double-star a non-stacking +1. Also add SITUATIONAL_SUPERSEDES['formation-master'] = ['formation-training'] (situationalBonuses.ts:2873) so the broader 'humanoid allies' wording replaces the narrower hobgoblin entry.

Confirmed data bug: grantedStrikes[0].damageType is the literal '{item|flags.system.rulesSelections.damage}'. The three replacement entries' choiceValue values (electricity/fire/cold) match the record's existing choice options exactly, so collectGrantedNaturals (build.ts:1002) resolves the right one. Well-formed.

Confirmed: derive.ts:1100 RAGE_DAMAGE covers only the damage tiers. fury-instinct is a barbarian SUBCLASS option; FEAT_PICK_GRANTS is consulted only for taken feats (build.ts:2177) and build.heritageId (2188), and subclass options support only fixed grantedFeats / grantedChoiceFeats (a fixed feat with a restricted sub-choice), never an open 1st-level class-feat pick. needsEngineWork honest; the UMT wizard bonus feat (build.ts:2079) is the precedent for the bespoke slot.
Confirmed: no field expresses 'add these spells to your spell list / spellbook / repertoire'. innateSpells, focusSpells and spellSlotBonus all mean something else. needsEngineWork correct.

Confirmed: critSpecWeapons.bases is ['{actor|flags.system.godlingWeapon}'] - an unresolved Foundry template, so weaponMatches (derive.ts:1166) narrows to nothing and the crit-spec never fires, and the +1d6 spirit is delivered by nothing. Situational strikeDamage is legal. The hierophant half is ally-side and correctly ignored.

Confirmed: zero hits in src/ and effect-backfill.json; 14 sibling ancestries ship this exact mirrorBestCategory shape. NOTE 1: this is a featGrantsAuto.ts FEAT_SKILL_GRANTS entry, not a record field (0 of 500+ records carry weaponFamiliarity). NOTE 2: the printed text lists only flails, khopeshes, mambeles, spears and war flails - drop 'spirit-thresher' unless deliberately covering the 'gnoll weapons' clause. All ids verified in core.items.

Confirmed unkeyed in featGrantsAuto/featGrantsLane/effect-backfill; all six weapon ids verified in core.items; mirrorBestCategory is the built lane (build.ts:2480). NOTE: author it as a FEAT_SKILL_GRANTS entry in featGrantsAuto.ts, not as a record field.
Confirmed unkeyed everywhere; all six ids verified in core.items. NOTE: belongs in featGrantsAuto.ts FEAT_SKILL_GRANTS, not on the record.

Confirmed: no field, no registry key; all 18 option ids verified in core.feats; effectChoices options without a grant are explicitly legal (types.ts:394-397). NOTE the cited sibling greater-awakened-power uses the `choice` lane with kind:'open', from:{type:'feat',traits:[...]} plus an `inert` warning string - more idiomatic here (traits:['automaton'], maxLevel 13) and it tells the player nothing is added to their statistics.
Confirmed unkeyed; all six ids verified in core.items. NOTE: FEAT_SKILL_GRANTS entry in featGrantsAuto.ts, not a record field.

Confirmed: no field. skillChoices.conditionalRank expresses exactly one base->upgraded pair, so 'expert if untrained OR master if trained' cannot be authored, and no lane gates a skill feat on the new rank. needsEngineWork correct.

Confirmed: the effect-backfill entry supplies only the pusakaLore `choice`; limitedUses covers Ancestral Recollection. The second activation (Guide My Dreams) prints no Frequency, so atWill:true + heightenHalfLevel:true is right, and both keys are legal on InnateSpellGrant (types.ts:521-535). Spell id 'guidance' verified.

Confirmed: no field, no registry key. The proposed `choice` matches the shipped flexible-transmogrification shape exactly (kind:'open', daily:true, from:{type:'feat',...}) and `daily` is a real ChoiceDef key (types.ts:670).

Confirmed: the situationalBonuses hit is only the +1 Kaiju Lore star. Backgrounds support grantedFeatId / grantedFeatByChoice (build.ts:331-345) and nothing else, and FEAT_PICK_GRANTS resolves for feat ids and build.heritageId only - an open 'one Athletics skill feat of your choice' has no background lane. needsEngineWork correct.

Confirmed: classFeatures['keen-recollection'] is reachable (investigator L3) but has zero engine fields and no code in src/ references it. Situational kind:'skill' detail:'all' is legal; the descriptive rather than numeric bonus string is already allowed by the star lane.

Confirmed unkeyed; all nine option ids verified in core.feats; options-without-grant is legal. Same NOTE as greater-augmentation: the `choice` kind:'open' + `inert` shape (greater-awakened-power) is more idiomatic and warns the player the benefit is prose.

Confirmed: no registry key; 'lion-scythe' and 'sun-sling' both verified in core.items; the text is the exact mirrorBestCategory sentence. NOTE: FEAT_SKILL_GRANTS entry in featGrantsAuto.ts, not a record field.

ALREADY MODELLED: casterArchetypes.ts:85 CASTER_ARCHETYPES['magaambyan-attendant-dedication'] = { traditionOptions:['arcane','primal'], keyByTradition (arcane->Int / primal->Wis), innateCantrip:true, cantrips:1 }, rendered as an innate archetype spellcasting entry at build.ts:2644. The chosen cantrip AND the tradition/key-ability spellcasting grant are both delivered; featGrantsAuto only ever needed to add the Arcana/Nature half.
Confirmed: trainedSkillChoice ['society','thievery'], choice flag 'counterSkill' records only, no feat grant. Text mapping verified; 'eye-for-numbers' and 'subtle-theft' both exist. Fix is exact.

Real defect confirmed (12 unconditional strikes, the name dedup keeps one ElementalCurrent, StrikingSurface damageType is a raw Foundry template) BUT THE FIX AS WRITTEN GRANTS NOTHING: collectGrantedNaturals skips any entry whose choiceValue !== the feat's choice value, and the record's existing choice offers only 'bludgeoning'/'slashing' (flag objectDamageType). The fix must ALSO replace `choice` with option values matching the new choiceValue strings (animal, celestial, elements-*, object-*, vegetation) or every strike is filtered out.

Confirmed: the heritage carries no field and no registry key; FEAT_PICK_GRANTS IS resolved for build.heritageId (build.ts:2188, shared.tsx:2403) with 'ancient-elf' as the shipped precedent. NOTE the fix labels the field 'featPickGrants'; the value is a valid FeatPickSpec and belongs as a key in src/rules/featPickGrants.ts.

Confirmed: featGrantsAuto.ts:206 is exactly { skills: { performance: 'trained' } } - the skill-feat half is unkeyed everywhere. FeatPickSpec.ids is the shipped exact-menu shape ('pitborn'), and all three option ids exist in core.feats.

Confirmed: the effect-backfill entry wrote a FLAT grantedFeatId 'cat-fall', so a Survival pick still hands out Cat Fall. grantedFeatByChoice is read first and replaces the flat grant entirely (build.ts:336-343); 'terrain-expertise' exists. The fix should REPLACE the effect-backfill grantedFeatId entry, not sit beside it.

Confirmed: featGrantsAuto.ts:212 is skillChoices only. FEAT_PICK_GRANTS category:'general' maxLevel:'self' is legal (advanced-general-training precedent). NOTE the language grant remains unmodelled after this fix.

Confirmed: the effect-backfill entry supplies only the Society/replacement-skill effectChoices, and EffectGrant has no feat lane. FEAT_PICK_GRANTS resolves for heritage ids (shared.tsx:2403); 'courtly-graces' and 'streetwise' both exist. Well-formed.
Confirmed: zero hits in src/ and effect-backfill.json; all six ids verified in core.items. NOTE: featGrantsAuto.ts FEAT_SKILL_GRANTS entry, not a record field.

Confirmed: FeatPickSpec filters by category/level/traits/dynamicTrait only - it cannot filter on a prerequisite string, and the legal pool depends on the order chosen in the same record. needsEngineWork correct.

Confirmed: the backfilled choice has flag 'feat' but no FEAT_PICK_GRANTS key, and Builder.tsx:1313 suppresses the plain choice renderer only when BOTH are present - so today it records and grants nothing. Adding the entry turns it into a real grant. NOTE critSpec/critSpecWeapons are already present and correct; only the four-weapon simple-proficiency clause is still unmodelled.

Confirmed: the choice records the branch and nothing else, and core.feats['caustic-nectar'] has no grantedStrikes so the nectar Strike does not exist. NOTE a situational entry (kind:'strikeDamage', when 'with your nectar unarmed Strike') would surface both branches TODAY - prefer that to needsEngineWork.

Confirmed: the choice (flag 'skillFeat') records only; grantedFeatByChoice is indexed by build.backgroundSkillChoice and this background has NO trainedSkillChoice at all; FEAT_PICK_GRANTS is resolved for feat and heritage ids only. No lane exists. needsEngineWork correct.
Confirmed: trainedSkillChoice ['acrobatics','performance'], choice flag 'promoterSkill' records only, no feat grant. Text mapping verified; 'steady-balance' and 'impressive-performance' both exist.

Confirmed: grantedSpells exists only on subclass options (types.ts:804), not on feats, and no field widens a tradition's spell list. The recorded choice covers only the prepared/spontaneous rider. needsEngineWork correct.

Confirmed: no fields, no registry key. SPELL_MARKERS (situationalBonuses.ts:2852) is exactly this lane - keyed by SPELL id with `source` naming the record the character must own - and the healing is player-side. Shape matches the shipped 'dancing-blade' entry.

ALREADY MODELLED: build.ts:2079-2083 injects build.umtFeatId as the extra 1st-level wizard CLASS feat (picker at Builder.tsx:467, recovery at build.ts:3435); Builder.tsx:234/445 add the extra spellbook spell via wizardSpellbookBudget(level, isUmtBook); build.ts:1615 gates off the curriculum slot and 6th cantrip. Only the Drain Bonded Item scaling is missing, and Drain Bonded Item / Arcane Bond are unmodelled for EVERY wizard (zero hits for 'drain-bonded' in src/), so it is not a UMT-specific gap.

Confirmed: the effect-backfill choice is explicitly marked inert ('the chosen feat and its benefits are not added to your sheet yet'), and FEAT_PICK_GRANTS has no key; 'elemental-existence' (featPickGrants.ts:71) is the identical shipped shape. Well-formed.

Confirmed: strikePrecisionRiders (derive.ts:1073) fires only on ownedFeatureIds.has('sneak-attack') and scales dice off character level; 'shadow-sneak-attack' appears nowhere in src/. NOTE a situational entry (kind:'strikeDamage', when 'vs an off-guard target with an agile/finesse or ranged Strike', bonus '+1d6 precision') would deliver this today - prefer that to needsEngineWork.

Confirmed: no fields, no registry key. All four option ids exist in core.feats and three already carry COMPANION_MODS entries, so the granted feat lands. FeatPickSpec.ids is the shipped exact-menu shape.

Confirmed: featGrantsAuto.ts:266 is skillChoices only. TWO CAVEATS: (a) the pool should be SKILL feats tied to the two skills chosen - category:'general' is broader than the rules allow; (b) build.pickFeatChoices is keyed by GRANTING FEAT ID, so a feat with maxTakable 5 can only store one pick and the repeat takes still owe feats.

Confirmed: featGrantsAuto.ts:267 is skillChoices only; no FEAT_PICK_GRANTS key. Same two caveats as skill-mastery (pool should be skill feats for the chosen skills; pickFeatChoices cannot store five picks under one feat id).

Confirmed: CompanionMod (companionGrants.ts:113-141) supports senses/speeds/maxHpBonus/iwr/strikeRider/maturityFloor/abilityBoosts/skillGrants/note - there is no feat lane at all, so an eidolon can never hold a skill feat. needsEngineWork correct.

Confirmed: same as shadow-sneak-attack - derive.ts:1073 is level-scaled and gated on the sneak-attack class feature, and 'sneak-attacker' appears nowhere in src/. NOTE a situational strikeDamage rider ('+1d4 precision, 1d6 from 6th, vs an off-guard target') would deliver it today without engine work.

Confirmed: a level-18 selectable archetype feat, edition 'neutral' (not an aon- scrape, not superseded), zero hits in src/. NOTE it is a straight duplicate of specialized-companion-animal-trainer (identical text; only the twin carries archetype:'animal-trainer'), so deduping is the alternative - but as shipped a player can take this copy and get nothing.

Grants Arcane Bond + Drain Bonded Item, neither of which is modelled for ANY wizard: classFeatures['arcane-bond'] carries zero engine fields (id/name/traits/description only) and 'drain-bonded' matches nothing in src/. A War Mage therefore ends up in exactly the same position as a normal wizard, nothing player-facing is lost, and the fix names no field or lane that would deliver anything.

Confirmed: the text reads 'your choice of the Dubious Knowledge or Quick Identification skill feat' - independent of the Occultism/Nature pick - so grantedFeatByChoice (indexed by build.backgroundSkillChoice) genuinely cannot express it, and backgrounds have no FEAT_PICK_GRANTS lane. needsEngineWork correct.
Confirmed: the effect-backfill entry only set trainedLoreChoice. The choice option labels literally read '(grants Crafter's Appraisal)' while granting nothing; both feat ids exist. Fix is exact.
Confirmed: no grantedFeatId and no grantedFeatByChoice; choice flag 'bgSkill' records only. Text mapping verified; 'hobnobber' and 'eye-for-numbers' both exist.
Confirmed: no feat grant of any kind; text mapping verified ('Survey Wildlife if you chose Survival or Impressive Performance if you chose Performance'); both ids exist.
Confirmed: the heritage carries no engine fields and no registry key; FEAT_PICK_GRANTS resolves for build.heritageId; 'everyday-form' and 'teakettle-form' both exist at level 1. Well-formed.

Real (no COMPANION_MODS key, zero hits in src/) BUT THE VALUE IS WRONG: the printed text gates the master Stealth on the companion being a SPECIALIZED AMBUSHER ('or legendary if it was already master'), so the unconditional skillGrants master would over-grant every animal companion. Ship the note alone, or gate it - CompanionMod has no conditional-skill shape.

Confirmed: swashbuckler.featProgression.skill already carries the extra 2/3/7/15 skill feats, but skillIncreaseLevels is the standard [3,5,7,...,19] and build.skillIncreases is keyed by LEVEL (build.ts:1355-1362), so a second increase at 3/7/15 is unrepresentable. needsEngineWork correct.

Confirmed: no fields, no registry key; core.actions.trip exists. RECORD_MARKERS on:'action' is the shipped lane and it already carries enemy-damage riders of this kind ('vicious-vengeance'), so the target-side rule does not disqualify it. Shape matches RecordMarker (situationalBonuses.ts:2800).

Confirmed: build.ts:3806 hardcodes exactly two 'bonus' fighter slots at levels 9 and 15, and featSlots.ts:78 caps each at slotLevel-1; 'ultimate-flexibility' appears nowhere in src/. needsEngineWork correct.

Confirmed: neither 'uncanny-dodge' nor 'deny-advantage' appears in src/; core.conditions['off-guard'] exists; RECORD_MARKERS on:'condition' is the shipped lane for a protection with no stat row ('the-fool' on stupefied). Shape is legal.

Confirmed: zero hits in src/ and effect-backfill.json, and the mirrored weapon is whatever Unconventional Weaponry chose - whose own backfilled choice is marked inert - so no static weaponFamiliarity list can express it. needsEngineWork correct.
Confirmed: no grantedFeatId and no grantedFeatByChoice; choice flag 'backgroundSkill' records only. Text mapping verified; 'group-impression' and 'intimidating-glare' both exist.

Confirmed: no hits in src/ or effect-backfill.json; the five ids (bo-staff, longbow, composite-longbow, scythe, staff) match the printed list exactly and all exist in core.items. NOTE: featGrantsAuto.ts FEAT_SKILL_GRANTS entry, not a record field.

Confirmed: abilityBoosts/trainedSkill/trainedLore only, no feat grant; grantedFeatByChoice keys off trainedSkillChoice which this background lacks, and EffectGrant has no feat lane. NOTE the source text is corrupt ('You gain either or Streetwise') - the first option name was lost in the AoN export, so the record needs a data repair before any lane can be authored.

Real (no fields; only viking-dedication and viking-weapon-familiarity are keyed) BUT THE FIX AS WRITTEN IS DANGEROUS: weaponMatches (derive.ts:1166) returns TRUE for every Strike when critSpecWeapons is absent, so critSpec:true alone grants UNIVERSAL critical specialization at level 6. It must ship with critSpecWeapons {bases:['battle-axe','hatchet','longsword','shortsword']} (all four verified) plus the separate featGrantsAuto weaponFamiliarity mirrorBestCategory entry for the expert-or-better clause.

The Diehard grant is genuinely missing and grantsFeats is the right field, BUT the record is currently UNREACHABLE: classFeatures['warrior-of-legend'] is in no class features list, is not a subclass option, and warrior-of-legend-dedication.classArchetype has NO addFeatures - so its existing effectChoices (the cursed weakness) are dead too. Apply the fix AND add addFeatures:[{level:1,featureId:'warrior-of-legend'}] to the dedication's classArchetype, or nothing lands.

ALREADY MODELLED: the exemplar dominion-epithet OPTION 'whose-cry-is-thunder' (core.classes.exemplar.extraChoices) carries grantedChoiceFeats:[{featId:'energized-spark',restrictTo:['electricity','sonic']}], applied at build.ts:2109/3261 - exactly the electricity-or-sonic Energized Spark grant. The judge checked only the classFeatures record, not the option that actually grants it.

Confirmed: no fields, no registry key; feats['wild-stride'] exists and grantsFeats is read for feats at build.ts:2206. NOTE wild-stride itself carries no engine fields, so the grant adds the feat row and prerequisite eligibility rather than a statistic.

limitedUses cannot deliver here, twice over: (1) classFeatures['act-together'] is an ORPHAN - no class features list, no subclass option, no extraChoice references it, so it never enters ownedFeatureIds; (2) even reachable class features get no pips, because FeatsTab.tsx:295 calls featUse(character, content.feats[e.featId]) and class-feature rows (FeatsTab.tsx:86-96) emit no featId. The 21 classFeatures that already carry limitedUses are dead data for the same reason.

Unobtainable: edition 'superseded', and AddItemsModal.tsx:118 hard-drops superseded items from the browse list regardless of the hideLegacy toggle, so no player can ever add it. There is also no live twin id to redirect the fix to.

Real (no companionGrants key) BUT NOT ENGINE WORK: FEAT_COMPANION_GRANTS already has abilityBudget + lockedAbilities + supersedes, so { kind:'familiar', label:'Enhanced Psychopomp Familiar', abilityBudget:4, lockedAbilities:['speech'], supersedes:['psychopomp-familiar'], note:'two of the four must come from Psychopomp Familiar's list or Augury' } delivers it today - exactly how improved-familiar-attunement supersedes 'familiar' at budget 4.

Confirmed: no fields and no situationalBonuses entry. The self half ('You and each of your allies within the sun's light deal an additional 1d6') is a real player-side rider, and strikeDamage/spellDamage are both legal SituationalTarget kinds.

Confirmed: StanceDef (types.ts:1417-1444) has resistances and a senseIfFeat rider ('senses a SEPARATE feat grants only while this form is active') but no resistance equivalent, so a feat-gated stance resistance genuinely has no lane. needsEngineWork correct, and rule 1 forbids proposing the toggle.

Confirmed: identical to inner-fire-monk (legacy-era printing, still selectable by default since only 'superseded' is force-hidden). Same missing lane - StanceDef.senseIfFeat exists but there is no resistanceIfFeat.

Confirmed: relic gift, edition 'remaster', addable (only superseded items are force-hidden), zero engine fields. innateSpells is top-level-legal on items and 'petrify' and 'sure-footing' both exist. NOTE the fix silently drops the second half - resistance 5 (8 underground) to physical while standing on earth - which needs passiveEffects.resistances and is conditional; flag it rather than losing it.

Confirmed: animalCompanions carry a single maneuver string, companionAdvanced has no primal-howl entry, and CompanionMod has no maneuver lane. NOTE the audited record is the classFeatures copy, which is an unreachable orphan - the player-facing record is feats['primal-howl'], so put any fix there; a COMPANION_MODS `note` would at least surface it on the companion card today.

Same as act-together: classFeatures['sickening-assault'] is unreachable (no class features list / subclass option / extraChoice references it) and limitedUses only renders through FeatsTab.tsx:295 featUse(content.feats[e.featId]) - class-feature rows carry no featId. The fix would write dead data.

Confirmed: level-18 unique invested item, zero engine fields, addable (only superseded is force-hidden; the empty price does not filter it). It is one of seven DISTINCT masks each with its own Understudy grant, not an umbrella summary. innateSpells is top-level-legal on items; 'heal' and 'breath-of-life' both exist. Well-formed.

Confirmed: same as the Grandmother - a distinct item with its own grant, no engine fields, addable. NOTE 'flame-strike' is edition 'superseded' in core.spells (SpellsTab.tsx:244 skips superseded), so the innate entry should point at the live remaster spell id or the row may not render; 'spirit-blast' is fine.
Confirmed: distinct item, no engine fields, addable; 'air-walk' and 'unfettered-movement' both exist in core.spells and innateSpells is top-level-legal on items. Well-formed.

Same as act-together: classFeatures['wyrms-breath'] is an orphan record (no class references it) and limitedUses never renders for class-feature rows (FeatsTab.tsx:86-96 emit no featId; featUse is keyed on content.feats). Inert either way.
